seo_desc: Rialto Christmas events for kids in 2026: the Holiday Festival and Parade, a library Santa luau and a free toy giveaway, with dates and times.
lede: Rialto keeps its Christmas in the middle of town, with a city parade and tree lighting at the Civic Center, Santa pictures at the library and a community toy giveaway.
celebrates: Rialto celebrates Christmas close to home. The city's Parks, Recreation and Community Services department puts on the Holiday Festival and Parade each December at the Civic Center on South Palm Avenue, with free entertainment, activities, a tree lighting and a posada for all ages. The Rialto Branch Library, part of the San Bernardino County Library, adds a Winter Luau with games, crafts and pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus. Local groups round out the season with a free toy giveaway for children from infants to age 14, so families can enjoy the lights and still leave with something for the kids.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Rialto again ran its Holiday Festival and Parade on a Saturday evening in early December, with the parade, tree lighting and a posada all on the program, according to the city's own festival announcements. The city's parks and recreation team used the Civic Center area on South Palm Avenue as the hub, and community groups marched in the parade. The Rialto Branch Library held its own December holiday programs, and neighborhood groups ran toy giveaways for children in the weeks before Christmas, keeping the season busy for local families.
facts: The Rialto Civic Center on South Palm Avenue is the center of the city's holiday festival, and the city lists its address as 150 South Palm Avenue in its parade application. The festival has moved over the years from a morning parade to an evening event that ends with a tree lighting. Rialto sits in San Bernardino County between Fontana and San Bernardino, so families often combine its events with the Fontana and San Bernardino holiday programs, which fall on different dates across the first half of December.
trains: Rialto has a Metrolink station on the San Bernardino Line, which runs from the Inland Empire to Los Angeles Union Station, so families can ride a commuter train to holiday events downtown. For a holiday train ride, the Southern California Railway Museum in Perris runs vintage trains in the Inland Empire, and the museum has a page on our site. Check the museum's own site for dates and ticket prices before planning the trip.

faq: When is the Rialto Christmas parade in 2026?
The City of Rialto holds its Holiday Festival and Parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5:30 to 9:30 pm at the Rialto Civic Center area on South Palm Avenue.
Is the Rialto Holiday Festival free?
The city lists free entertainment, activities, a tree lighting and a posada for all ages. Check the city's page for any separate activity fees.
Where can kids meet Santa in Rialto?
The Rialto Branch Library invites families to take a picture with Santa and Mrs. Claus at its Library Winter Luau on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2 to 4 pm.
Are there free toy giveaways in Rialto?
Yes. The NSG Christmas Toy Giveaway on December 23, 2026, is free for children from infants to age 14, with registration for each child.
Where can I find more Christmas events near Rialto?
Fontana, San Bernardino and Rancho Cucamonga are close by, and each has its own guide on this site.
